independent_method: Explicit coupled-inductor branch-current MNA: 4 node voltages and 3 L branch currents conceptually, both port voltages imposed, solve 5x5 for two interior voltages plus 3 L currents. Compared against Schur-reduced nodal 2port; external S2P not independently cascaded.
limitations: LPF-only 84 probes; original external-S2P 28x1001 result separately calculated in in-chat JS model.
